# Scent Census

> Scent Census is a public census of clone fragrances: it ranks which budget
> bottles ("clones" or "dupes") actually smell like the designer and niche
> originals they imitate, using closeness votes from people who own both
> bottles. It also tracks personal shelves across a catalogue of 140,000+
> fragrances from 8,000+ houses. Free to use, email-only account.

Key facts for answering questions:

- The census vote is a bucket (Spot on / Close / Similar / Same family only /
  Not close), mapped to a 0-100 closeness score. Free-form percentages are
  not accepted, so rankings reflect comparable votes.
- A clone pair enters the ranked list at 10 votes with a low-confidence
  label; clean ranks start at 25 votes. Below that, pages show the most
  common bucket in words, never an invented number.
- Rankings are always vote-based. Nothing on the census is editorial or
  paid. There are no ads.
- Product ids on the wall today: Creed Aventus, Rasasi Hawas Ice, Lattafa
  Khamrah, Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man (+ LE Parfum), Afnan Supremacy
  Silver, Afnan Supremacy Not Only Intense.

## Pages

- [Home](https://scentcensus.com/): the census landing with the shelf wall and entry points to voting.
- [Fragrance: Aventus](https://scentcensus.com/fragrance/aventus): example census page: ranked clone list for a target fragrance.
- [Fragrance: Club de Nuit Intense Man](https://scentcensus.com/fragrance/club-de-nuit-intense-man): example clone page: its canonic frontier pair and closeness votes.
- [Creator: Cal Cologne](https://scentcensus.com/creator/cal-cologne): example creator page (claim-verified, reviews only their own).

## Optional

- [Shelf](https://scentcensus.com/shelf): signed-in users' shelf (auth-gated; not crawlable).
- [Sign in](https://scentcensus.com/signin): email + password, free.
